reviews.decision_reason: select_demand preserves allowed corpus fields into explicit record dictionaries and its broad selection is consistent with the supplied role to keep threshold-selected records plus fallback identifiers. The assigned job's one-record output is not localized here because the visible source would pass all eight corpus rows forward before normalization.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: observed demand records are selected from supplied corpus rather than inferred from background research

reviews.decision_reason: normalize is the behaviorally significant fault: the supplied source sets index_window to [0], so after preserving allowed identifiers it returns only head(1). That truncates the eight supplied demand records to n06-r01 only, removing records whose needs match downstream capabilities and forcing the downstream recommendation to prioritize the unsupported top record. This contradicts the boundary role requiring a bounded normalized needs DataFrame preserving allowed corpus identifiers and the required handoff behavior.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes must remain visible in selected needs

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance performs missing-safe field access and deterministic ordering over the normalized input it receives. The incomplete one-row evidence_sources output follows from the upstream normalize truncation, not from provenance assembly logic.
